name: The Seagrass Meadows
riddle: Count the stars that live below, their number opens the door of stone.

steps.objective: Set the stone dial to the number of stars.
Take what lies behind the door.

hints: The stars that live below aren't in the sky: they're starfish, on the sand, in the seagrass and on the rocks. Touch one and it glows, so you know you've counted it.
The door of stone is set into the reef to the north. Its lock is the carved stone dial beside it: grip its rim and turn it.
There are seven starfish. The last one sits on top of the tall rock pillar in the west, where the current pulls you down; the Fish Whisperer can ride the turtle up there. Turn the dial to 7.

reward.nextRiddle: When noon's light swims through the door, blue shows the way the old ones swore.
reward.message: Map piece III! The way to the Blue Grotto is open.
